name: Nadir panel (array mounting deck)
material: Al 5056 honeycomb sandwich, 0.5 mm Al 6061 skins (effective density)

name: Zenith panel
material: Al 5056 honeycomb sandwich, 0.5 mm Al 6061 skins (effective density)

name: ±X side panel
material: Al 5056 honeycomb sandwich, 0.5 mm Al 6061 skins (effective density)

name: ±Z side panel
material: Al 5056 honeycomb sandwich, 0.5 mm Al 6061 skins (effective density)

name: Shear deck with tank cut-out
material: Al 5056 honeycomb sandwich, 0.5 mm Al 6061 skins (effective density)

name: Launch-adapter ring, 15-inch (spacecraft side)
function: Carries all launch loads into the rideshare separation system

name: Array panel structure (CFRP / honeycomb)
material: CFRP-skinned Al honeycomb antenna panel (effective density)
process: Co-cured CFRP skins on Al honeycomb, flatness 0.5 mm
function: Holds 136 subarrays flat to λ/16 so the beam forms correctly

name: Radiating subarray, 6 patches (X-band)
material: Rogers RO4350B patch subarray, copper radiators
function: Radiates and receives; one per T/R module

name: GaN T/R module, 6 W peak
material: GaN T/R module (Kovar lid, LTCC substrate)
function: Amplifies the chirp on transmit and the echo on receive; sets phase for beam steering

name: Panel controller and power board
function: Distributes timing, beam-steering words and 28 V to the panel’s T/R modules

name: Array back radiator
material: Aluminium radiator, white silicate paint (ε 0.9, α 0.2)
process: Painted Al sheet, bonded to TRM heat spreaders
function: Radiates T/R module heat to space after each imaging pass

name: Deployment hinge (spring motor, damper, latch)
function: Swings a wing panel open at a controlled rate and latches it flat

name: Hold-down release mechanism (SMA pin-puller)
function: Clamps a stowed wing through launch; releases on command

name: Solar panel substrate
material: CFRP / Al honeycomb solar substrate (effective density)

name: Solar cell blanket, 0.58 m² triple-junction
material: Triple-junction GaAs cells with 100 µm coverglass
function: About 220 W at normal sun per panel at beginning of life

name: Power conditioning and distribution unit
function: Solar MPPT, battery charge, 28 V bus, latching current limiters

name: Reaction wheel, 1.0 N·m·s / 0.1 N·m
function: Four in a pyramid; slews the spacecraft into imaging attitude

name: AIS receiver (4-channel, 161.975 / 162.025 MHz)
function: Hears ships’ own position reports, to match against radar detections and flag dark vessels

name: L-band relay modem (low-latency ship lists)
function: Sends detection lists through a commercial relay constellation within minutes

name: SAR central electronics (chirp, receiver, digitiser, timing)
function: Generates the chirp, times every pulse and digitises the echoes

name: Payload power unit with supercapacitor bank
function: Supplies the T/R modules’ pulsed current so the battery sees a smooth load

name: Mass memory and on-board processor (1.5 TB, FPGA + GPU)
function: Stores raw data, forms images and runs ship detection on board
